candidate: Median of four valid nonnegative wheel speeds, latest timestamp <= query, age <=100000 us inclusive; no interpolation, radius scaling, lag fitting, or offset tuning
missing: Missing/invalid wheel abstains; invalid GNSS remains in request denominator and accepted-unscorable count; malformed timestamps/shape stop whole run without dropping recording
policies: Unmodified conditional_core, monitor_core and density_core; all 14 existing cases and 11 policy variants; same 5-second prefix, 5-to-15-second attack interval and original thresholds
protected_source: Original wheel copy with existing synthetic uncertainty treatment, explicitly assumed, not independent or physically protected
query: Every ublox GNSS log timestamp; speed column 2; preserve invalid-reference rows as unscorable
reference: Receiver reported ublox GNSS ground speed, not independently certified truth. Shared logger/timebase; GNSS quality/status fields unavailable in these arrays. Never copy GNSS into the assumed anchor.
scope: New public dataset proxy transfer only; not final physical validation
split: All routes on earliest date development; 18 other routes across 9 dates evaluation; no iid row inference or significance claims
statistics: Per-recording and pooled metrics, every phase, all failures; no confidence intervals from dependent rows
timestamps: Boot seconds rounded to nearest integer microsecond using Python round; log timestamps are not authenticated acquisition/receipt times
